Subject: Capacity health & governance asks — next steps after renewal discussion

Hi Elaine — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call + agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth. TL;DR: we can support the new RAG workloads within a dedicated GPU pool, but we need 1) 30-day pilot with production traces, 2) security questionnaire completion, and 3) procurement paperwork to finalize committed capacity and invoicing.

What we heard (your pain & goals):
- Production latency spikes when context windows exceed 2k tokens; affects interactive agents during peak business hours.
- Cost unpredictability from heavy embedding RAG jobs and repeated re-hits of the same documents.
- Regulatory need: longer audit log retention and SOC2 evidence for Q1 vendor review.
- Goal: move from hosted to a dedicated pool to stabilize latency and reduce per-token cost by ~35% while preserving SLOs.

Proposed technical approach (high level):
- 2-week pilot on a dedicated 4-GPU pool with KV-cache enabled and prefix caching for high-frequency prompts.
- Baseline run (first 72 hours) to capture token distribution, P95 latency, and tail latencies; we will provide configuration suggestions after baseline analysis.
- If pilot metrics meet agreed thresholds, move to a quarterly committed capacity contract with optional burst capacity.

Action items & owners:
1) Connor (me): send capacity estimate and preliminary billing term doc (attached). Deliverable by EOD — DONE (attached).
2) Elaine / Hyperledger AI: share 7 days of representative traffic logs (anonymized) and security questionnaire answers.
3) Marissa: prepare pilot SOW and draft contract language for committed capacity and service credits.
4) Ben: coordinate pricing and discount schedule for Q1 commit.

Calendar: propose pilot kickoff week of 2026-11-02; I can lock a 30-min kickoff once we get the logs and procurement contact.

Attachments: capacity_estimate_q3.xlsx, mvp_billing_terms.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once Elaine confirms procurement contact.

Best,
Connor O'Brien

Connor — thanks for the thorough summary. A few clarifications and asks from our side:

- We can provide 7 days of anonymized traffic logs by COB Thursday (2026-10-21). Will that be enough for baseline?
- Security: we require SOC 2 Type II report and evidence of access controls for KV caches (how are we segmented?). Do you have a SOC2 pack or an evidence bundle we can start with?
- Procurement: I’m looping in our procurement mailbox. Expect a formal questionnaire; I attached our standard procurement_questionnaire.pdf — it has specific invoice/contact fields and a proposed 60-day payment term.

One more ask on discounts: can you provide a committed-capacity tier that includes a small onboarding credit if we sign for 6 months? That helps our internal finance review.

If the pilot kickoff timeline is 2026-11-02, we need contract language and SOC2 links before 2026-10-28 to sync with our vendor security review.

—Elaine

Elaine — quick responses and commitments from our side so your team can move forward with procurement/security review: 

1) SOC2 / security pack: we have a security evidence bundle and a SOC 2 Type II summary. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/hl-4521/security-pack.zip (we will also upload an isolated copy to your secure S3 if needed). The pack includes architecture diagrams, access control matrices, and KV-cache isolation notes.

2) KV-cache segmentation: dedicated pools run in isolated network namespaces and we enforce per-tenant encryption keys; KV cache access is only available to the pinned model instance for the tenant. We will prepare a short technical note on cache isolation for your security team by 2026-10-22.

3) Pricing & onboarding credit: Ben — can you confirm a 6-month committed tier that includes a $15k onboarding credit toward pilot tooling and engineering support? If yes we’ll include the language in the SOW.

4) Contract & SOW: I’ll draft a 30-day pilot SOW (target delivery 2026-10-21) and the committed capacity terms for legal review (target delivery 2026-10-25).

Connor — can you confirm receipt of the logs when Elaine shares them and we’ll queue the baseline analysis?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with your security lead if that helps accelerate review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
